purpose: Predeclare package hypotheses to test only after the active expanded architecture wave completes; do not trigger a competing workflow.
promotion_gate: Controlled paired sim-v2 confirmation remains authoritative; tournament prevalence is hypothesis generation only.

packages.hypothesis: A current-metagame copy-density package improves both self-contained redundancy and opportunistic value without requiring the full six-card heavy-copy architecture.
packages.evidence_note: EDHTop16 one-year 60+ player Kinnan staples currently reports Mirage Mirror 90.3%, Mirrormade 70.0%, Imposter Mech 51.9%, Copy Enchantment 46.2%; cEDHStats six-month Kinnan sample reports Imposter Mech 54.8% and Copy Enchantment 51.2%.

packages.hypothesis: Artifact-weighted copy density may preserve Kinnan/rock synergy with fewer context-dependent enchantment slots.
Compact Druid/Effigy plus creature-tutor access may outperform broad clone density if the extra deterministic node is the actual source of architecture gains.

measurement.confirmation: 2,000-5,000+ paired games adaptively only while decision-relevant
measurement.primary_endpoint: strict protected deterministic attempt by end of Kinnan T4
report: conditional paired effect when package slot exposed
